name: gizza-ai/seo-audit
summary: Audit HTML for on-page SEO issues

tool.description: Audit pasted HTML for common on-page SEO issues — missing or poorly sized <title> and meta description, H1 usage, skipped heading levels, images missing alt text, canonical link, and Open Graph tags — and return a 0–100 score with per-check findings. Pass the page HTML as `html`.

html.description: The full HTML source of the page to audit (paste the page's <head> and <body>).
